g.text: Bottom: 56,784 total formal calls; four balanced rounds; 4,060 calls per version/public configuration. No retrieval repeated here.

g.text: All formal automatic gates passed; no resource waiver. OS/SQLite caches warm naturally; these are not OS-cold measurements.

g.text: No claim of statistical significance, whole-product speed or universal speedup. All negative cells and resource costs are retained.
